visual_summary: A heavily armored man arrives in a grand interior hall by small craft and moves through a ceremonial crowd while thinking angrily about suitors around an idealized princess statue. He resolves not to use his weapons so his identity as the Metabaron stays hidden until his revenge is complete. A guard orders him into line, and the page ends with a formal offering scene in which a courtly figure presents a rose while the crowd admires a marble statue made from the ruins of a defeated amphibian stronghold and promises the princess a strong son.
